title: Grade 4 Science — Ways Energy Moves and Changes
subject: Science
description: Practice with questions on light, heat, sound, motion, transfer.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: What form of energy from a lamp makes a page visible?
What form of energy reaches your ear from a vibrating drum?
In a toaster, electrical energy is used mainly to produce what effect on bread?
Where does thermal energy move when ice is placed in warmer water?
choices: from the ice to the warmer water
from the warmer water to the ice

questions.question: Which shows light energy being absorbed and warming something?
choices: A magnet attracts a paper clip.
A black shirt warms in sunlight.
A bell rings in a dark room.
A ball rolls down a hill in the dark.

questions.question: What produces the sound of a plucked rubber band?
Where does a running person's body get energy used by muscles?
A ramp is used to roll a ball down. When does the ball have the most motion energy?
choices: when it is still in a storage bin

questions.question: Which appliance uses electrical energy to create moving air?
Which part of a solar-powered calculator receives light?
Touching a warm mug makes your fingers warmer. What moved into your fingers?
Which lets you compare how sunlight warms two surfaces?
choices: Put one in sunlight and one in a freezer.
Change both light and time together.
Measure temperatures before and after equal time in the same sunlight.
Measure only how wide each surface is.

questions.question: Which step reduces thermal energy leaving a warm drink most directly?
choices: Stir the drink with a cold metal spoon.
Put an ice cube in the drink.
Cover the mug with an insulating sleeve.
Pour it into a wider open bowl.

questions.question: Which movement mostly powers a wind turbine?
Which may show energy transferred by a collision?
choices: A book rests on a desk.
A pencil stays in an unopened box.
A rolling ball hits a still ball and the still ball moves.

questions.question: What enters a battery-powered speaker and is changed into sound?
When two hands rub together, which change can be measured?
choices: a change in the time of day

questions.question: What happens to light hitting a clean mirror?
A transmission of energy can occur without materials touching. Which example shows this?
choices: A moving puck hits another puck.
A warm spoon touches a hand.

questions.question: Why does the pitch rise if you tighten a guitar string and pluck it the same way?
